metaTitle: Gabriel Moro — Senior Mobile Engineer & Content Creator
metaDescription: Senior mobile engineer and tech lead working with Android, Kotlin Multiplatform and Flutter. Articles, videos, podcast and talks on mobile engineering, architecture and open source.

hero.title: Learn mobile
hero.titleEmphasis: from someone who ships every day.
hero.lede: I’m Gabriel Moro. For almost a decade I’ve built Android, Kotlin Multiplatform and Flutter products used by millions — and I turn those decisions into articles, videos and talks for the community.
hero.portraitAlt: Portrait of Gabriel Moro, smiling and wearing glasses.

about.heading: Engineering in production, knowledge in public.
paragraphs: I’ve been a mobile engineer since 2017, building and leading products at scale — apps with 35M+ users and 100M+ downloads — as a senior engineer and tech lead. Today I work with Flutter and the VTEX ecosystem at Kobe.

Sharing what I learn has always been part of the job. I write about architecture, testing and Kotlin Multiplatform, make videos at CodandoTV and speak at GDGs and DevFests. My approach is simple: less abstract theory, more real engineering decisions and examples you can apply to your own project.

content.heading: What I learn, I write down.
content.lede: Technical writing on Android, Kotlin Multiplatform, architecture and mobile careers — grounded in real engineering decisions, not abstract theory.

roles.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
bullets: Building and evolving mobile e-commerce apps with Flutter and Dart, across the full product lifecycle.
Improving architecture, engineering practices and automated testing for scalable, high-quality delivery.
Integrating with the VTEX ecosystem and supporting technical leadership, code reviews and knowledge sharing across the team.

roles.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
bullets: Core features for a cash-back app with 35M+ users, handling millions of daily transactions.
Led Kotlin Multiplatform (Compose Multiplatform) adoption and supported mobile developers technically.
Feature flags, CI/CD with linting and Maestro UI tests, and architecture standards across the team.

roles.title: Senior Android Engineer
bullets: Delivered Android features for a carrier app with 25M–35M+ active users and 100M+ downloads.
Worked closely with Android developers and built complex features with Hilt, Jetpack Compose and multi-module projects.

roles.title: Senior Android Engineer
bullets: Built core Android features for an enterprise video recording and livestreaming app.
Implemented HD local recording, low-latency capture and a dynamic multi-participant video display.
Worked with WebRTC, Dagger and Jetpack Components on a live production product.
